manual_findings: The compact response completed and identified the two distinct Stanlib acquisition events.
The first transaction quotation altered the supplied corrupted quotation characters, so two uses of that quotation failed exact evidence matching.
The second transaction quotation matched exactly, but chunk-level validation rejected the complete response after the first quotation failed.
The response found both expected signal types: Aker market entry and the Aker/Mainstream acquisition.
It split Aker's single real-world transaction into separate market-entry and M&A event records instead of attaching both supported signals to one event.
It added a separate Mainstream M&A event for the same transaction even though the frozen gold treats Aker as the subject and Mainstream as the counterparty.
All six quotations in this chunk matched the prepared evidence exactly.

aggregate_review.conclusion: The compact contract prevented token-limit truncation, but exact-quote reliability and event grouping remain insufficient for a dependable first pass.
